import numpy as np, collections

def transform(grid):
    a=np.array(grid,dtype=int)
    h,w=a.shape
    counts=np.bincount(a.ravel(), minlength=10)
    base=int(np.argmax(counts))
    # The ruling color is the most common non-background color.
    line=int(sorted(range(10), key=lambda x: counts[x], reverse=True)[1])
    rs=[i for i in range(h) if np.count_nonzero(a[i]==line)>w/2]
    cs=[j for j in range(w) if np.count_nonzero(a[:,j]==line)>h/2]
    # Crossings marked with another color define the useful grid extent.
    active_r=[i for i in rs if any(a[i,j]!=line for j in cs)]
    active_c=[j for j in cs if any(a[i,j]!=line for i in rs)]
    while active_r and active_r[0]==rs[0] and not any(a[active_r[0],j]!=line for j in cs): active_r.pop(0)
    while active_r and active_r[-1]==rs[-1] and not any(a[active_r[-1],j]!=line for j in cs): active_r.pop()
    while active_c and active_c[0]==cs[0] and not any(a[i,active_c[0]]!=line for i in rs): active_c.pop(0)
    while active_c and active_c[-1]==cs[-1] and not any(a[i,active_c[-1]]!=line for i in rs): active_c.pop()
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in zip(active_r,active_r[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c0,c1 in zip(active_c,active_c[1:]):
            corners=[int(a[r0,c0]),int(a[r0,c1]),int(a[r1,c0]),int(a[r1,c1])]
            vals=a[r0+1:r1,c0+1:c1]
            fill=int(np.bincount(vals.ravel(),minlength=10).argmax()) if vals.size else base
            row.append(corners[0] if corners.count(corners[0])==4 and corners[0]!=line else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out

# Generate both demonstration inputs exactly from their regular structure.
d1=np.ones((17,27),dtype=int)
for c in [0,7,14,21]: d1[:,c]=3
for r in [1,5,9,13]: d1[r,:]=3
for r in [1]:
    d1[r,14]=2; d1[r,21]=2
for r in [5,9]:
    d1[r,0]=0; d1[r,7]=0; d1[r,14]=2; d1[r,21]=2
out1=[[1,1,2],[0,1,2]]
print('demo1',transform(d1.tolist()), transform(d1.tolist())==out1)

d2=np.full((28,28),7,dtype=int)
for r in [0,5,10,15,20,25]: d2[r,:]=5
for c in [1,7,13,19,25]: d2[:,c]=5
crosses={0:[5,1,1,2,2],5:[5,1,1,2,2],10:[1,1,1,2,2],15:[1,1,1,2,2],20:[0,0,2,2,5],25:[0,0,2,2,5]}
for r,vals in crosses.items():
    for c,v in zip([1,7,13,19,25],vals): d2[r,c]=v
out2=[[7,1,7,2],[7,1,7,2],[1,1,7,2],[7,7,7,7],[0,7,2,7]]
print('demo2',transform(d2.tolist()), transform(d2.tolist())==out2)

test=np.full((30,28),3,dtype=int)
for r in [1,14,27]: test[r,:]=4
for c in [0,13,26]: test[:,c]=4

        if (r,c)!=(27,26): test[r,c]=7
